entities.summary: Huadong Hospital or East China Hospital, founded in 1921 as the Country Hospital, is a teaching hospital in Shanghai, China, affiliated with the Shanghai Medical College of Fudan University. Its main building, designed by László Hudec, is a Municipal Heritage Building of Shanghai. Huadong Hospital is a medical organization in Asia, established in 1951.
